name: CAT DEFENSE [Alpha]
desc:
🐱 CATS ARE INVADING THE PLANET! 🪐

Grab some shells, load the cannons, and fire away.💥 Work with your crew, defend the fort, and survive the unstoppable CAT-astrophe!

🔥 FIRE CANNONS
🐾 DEFEAT ENEMY CATS
🛡️ DEFEND THE PLANET

Can you survive the invasion, or will the cats claim your planet? 😼
